destination.events: public.research_events (one row per record; owner_id and received_at set by the server)
destination.content: public.research_content rows + private Storage bucket research-content/<owner>/<sha256> (gzip parts, manifests for > 4 MiB); events reference it through content_refs

causality.rule: One user operation (click, keyboard shortcut, menu command, composer Enter, headless command) has exactly one action.invoke, whose id is its action_id. The first semantic product action names it; a generic click/shortcut/menu record is written only when no semantic action claimed the operation within 300 ms. Further semantic names for the same operation stay in the legacy desktop_events stream.
causality.action_id: the primary action that initiated the record
causality.caused_by: the record that directly caused this one (turn_start -> action; user message -> turn_start; assistant text -> user message; tool.end -> tool.start; agent-written version -> tool.end of the writing call; resolved question/permission -> answering action)
causality.parent_action_id: metadata.parent_action_id: the enclosing operation when one happens inside another (an answer or permission reply during a turn, a message sent while a turn runs, an automatic paper build authorized by the paper import/create)

native_ids.conversation.message (assistant): message_id = native OpenCode message id when reported (metadata.native_id_reported); metadata.native_part_ids
native_ids.tool.start / tool.end: tool_call_id = native OpenCode callID (fallback: part id, marked native_id_reported=false); metadata.native_message_id, metadata.native_part_id
native_ids.agent.turn_end: metadata.native_user_message_id (OpenCode user message id, from the kernel identity event) and metadata.user_message_id (the captured user message)
native_ids.conversation.question: message_id = metadata.question_id = native question request id

unlinked_labels.baseline: state observed when a project opens or the headless worker starts (desktop: no action; headless: linked to command.start)
unlinked_labels.external: a change no operation of this process caused (another editor, a session started elsewhere)
unlinked_labels.not-reported: metadata.action_link on a human save whose caller sent no operation id (older renderer)

version_links.human: metadata.trigger = human-save; action_id = the save operation (write-capture.ts attribution decides human vs agent by the exact saved bytes)
version_links.agent: metadata.trigger = agent-tool; tool_call_id/caused_by = the tool call whose input names the file, else the running call, else the latest call in the project within 60 s (metadata.writer_link says which); else agent-turn

never_collected: individual keystrokes (a shortcut records only its name, e.g. shortcut:cmd+b, and only when no product action claimed it)
credentials, tokens, account email, absolute machine paths (scrubbed by scrubResearchValue before persistence)

session.start.desktop: research-collector.ts enqueue (first record of a run)

consent.change.desktop: gap: agreement changes are recorded in research_consents and legacy consent.changed, not as a v1 event
consent.change.headless: not_applicable: the account profile carries the agreement

action.invoke.desktop: renderer capture.ts (document click, shortcut keydown) + Chat.tsx (composer Enter) + App.tsx menu.onCommand -> shared/research-operations.ts createOperations -> telemetry:track IPC -> research-agent.ts interaction/action; downstream IPCs (kernel:send/abort/reply/answerQuestion/rejectQuestion/native, project:writeText/importFiles/startBuild/retryBuild, projects:create) carry the operation id
action.invoke.headless: scripts/headless-research.mjs: command.start (worker launch) and command.<op> for every JSON-lines command; UI clicks/shortcuts/menus not_applicable

view.dwell.desktop: tab.switch / thread.switch / source.page with duration (Workbench, Studies, useSession, SourceDrawer); linked to the click that ended the dwell

source.page_dwell.desktop: gap: source page dwell is captured as view.dwell (target page.N) because the renderer does not know the source sha256

selection.commit.desktop: App.tsx selection.change, SourceDrawer source.select, telemetry.ts onThreadCapture workspace-context (linked to the send)

annotation.commit.desktop: SourceDrawer saveAnnotation -> source.annotated / source.annotation_removed (annotation id + anchor: source, pages, bounds)

conversation.message.desktop: research-agent.ts start (user, full text) / checkpoint (assistant, partial + final segments)

conversation.question.desktop: research-agent.ts event(question); answers link to the answering operation (agent.answer before kernel.answerQuestion)

tool.end.desktop: research-agent.ts event(tool completed/error) with complete output; interrupted at turn end

permission.decision.desktop: research-agent.ts event(permission resolved); researcher replies link to the reply operation (agent.permit)

agent.runtime.desktop: gap: kernel install/runtime state is in the legacy stream only
agent.runtime.headless: gap: worker doctor/provenance is written to the local run log only

program.version.desktop: telemetry.ts snapshotProgram (exact bytes committed under the save lock, attributed by write-capture.ts) + researchAgent.versionLink

source.import.desktop: telemetry.ts queueSource: projects:create / project:importFiles operations (noteImport) or baseline at project open
source.import.headless: headless-research.mjs at launch (linked to command.start, trigger baseline)

web: Mirrored separately in humanstudy-hub-web (T08). The web adapter must emit the same action.invoke-per-operation rule and the same action_id / caused_by / metadata.parent_action_id meanings; see docs/research-data.md#causality-t10.
